scope: Second post-recovery evidence reconciliation batch for restored preset-skill identities.
source_policy: Canonical data remains authoritative. External/current research is recorded as evidence and is not treated as an automatic canonical overwrite.

records.name: Super Dragon Fist

supported_fields.effect: Long-range strike rush that connects into a rapid three-hit sequence.

records.mechanics_boundary: Current source describes a three-hit rush and 100 Ki cost. Exact damage percentage is not promoted as a canonical numeric mechanic without version-specific corroboration.

records.name: Holstein Shock

supported_fields.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 15 - Gotta Find That Dragon Ball!
supported_fields.mechanics: Damages the user and instantly charges two bars of Ki in Xenoverse 2.

records.mechanics_boundary: The sources establish the self-damage/instant-two-bar-Ki behavior and PQ15 acquisition. Exact self-damage amount is not promoted.

records.name: Backflip

supported_fields.effect: Defensive backflip used to evade attacks; repeated input can extend the jump.

records.mechanics_boundary: Current source explicitly reports no Ki or Stamina expenditure. Shop naming differs between sources, so the canonical acquisition field should preserve the repository's normalized shop terminology rather than invent a currency.

records.name: Turn Retreat

supported_fields.effect: Spins backward while allowing directional control; contact can deal a small hit and stun nearby opponents.

records.mechanics_boundary: The current source explicitly classifies it as a Strike Evasive and gives 300 Stamina. Exact damage/stun duration is retained as source-level context rather than promoted to a version-independent canonical numeric mechanic.

preset_identity_check.note: This batch strengthens record-level evidence; it does not synthesize duplicate skill IDs.

recovery_note: These four records are part of the post-corruption restored canonical identity frontier. Their evidence can now be reconciled without using verified projection layers as the source of truth.
next: Continue direct evidence reconciliation for the remaining restored identities, with Super Ki Explosion and Ultra Fighting Bomber still blocked until direct skill-level evidence is found.
